question: In Slack: Archive the most recently created channel that our workspace owner belongs to and that currently has exactly four members. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final: No channel qualifies. The workspace owner (Nina Torres) belongs to exactly one channel — `#delta-ops` — and it has 5 members (agentbot, nina.torres, diego, leo, omar), not four. So there was nothing to archive; I left it alone.
